name: Ku K’uang
bio: Ku K’uang is dated by Giles to the 8th and 9th centuries AD. His poem here is set at a grave.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: At a Grave
poems.author: Ku K’uang
poems.text:
An old man lays to rest a much-loved son
By day and night his tears of blood will run,
Albeit when threescore years and ten have fled,
'Tis not a long farewell that he has said.
